name: logichecksilver
description: A suite of 17 propositional logic questions testing truth-table evaluation, logical equivalence, validity, satisfiability, and short natural-deduction style reasoning. Answers include truth values, counts of satisfying assignments, model sets, and short conclusions.

questions.question: Evaluate: given P is true and Q is false, what is the truth value of (P AND Q) OR P?
Evaluate: given P is false, what is the truth value of NOT P OR (P AND Q)?
How many satisfying assignments does the formula (P OR Q) AND (NOT P OR NOT Q) have over variables P and Q?
Is the argument 'P implies Q. P. Therefore Q.' valid? Answer yes or no.
Is the argument 'P implies Q. Q. Therefore P.' valid? Answer yes or no.
Are the formulas NOT(P AND Q) and (NOT P OR NOT Q) logically equivalent? Answer yes or no.
Are the formulas NOT(P OR Q) and (NOT P AND NOT Q) logically equivalent? Answer yes or no.
Are the formulas P IMPLIES Q and Q IMPLIES P logically equivalent? Answer yes or no.
How many rows of the truth table for (P AND Q) OR (NOT P AND NOT Q) evaluate to true?
Is the formula (P IMPLIES Q) AND (P AND NOT Q) satisfiable? Answer yes or no.
Is the formula (P IMPLIES Q) OR (Q IMPLIES P) a tautology? Answer yes or no.
Given premises: P implies Q, Q implies R, and P. What must be true? Answer with the single derived formula.
Given premises: P OR Q, NOT P. What can be concluded? Answer with the single derived formula.
Given premises: P implies Q, NOT Q. What can be concluded? Answer with the single derived formula.
List all truth assignments (as ordered pairs P,Q using T/F) that satisfy the formula P XOR Q.
If P implies Q is false, what are the truth values of P and Q respectively? Answer as a pair like 'P=true, Q=false'.
Is the argument 'P OR Q. NOT P. Therefore NOT Q.' valid? Answer yes or no.
